# ShareIt

> ShareIt is a privacy-first family photo and video sharing app.

ShareIt is a privacy-first family photo and video sharing app that makes sharing between children and elders safer. Core mechanisms: content requires authorization before sharing, with a delayed regret window so you can undo; child and elder roles are separated for selective sharing; image-sensitive content gets an extra confirmation layer. Offers free expiring storage and permanent member storage.

## Key Features
- Delayed confirmation delivery: undo with one tap during the regret window
- Role-based permissions: direct content to the right role without cross-noise
- Image protection layer: extra confirmation and authorization filtering
- Flexible storage modes: free auto-expiring, or permanent member storage
